name: E-Commerce Development
heroSubtitle: Powerful online stores designed to help businesses showcase products, serve customers and grow their digital sales.
shortDescription: We build modern e-commerce websites with intuitive shopping experiences, product management and secure checkout integrations.
fullDescription: TOP TECH develops professional e-commerce solutions that help businesses establish and grow their online stores. From product catalogues and shopping carts to checkout integrations and order management, we create user-friendly shopping experiences designed around your business needs. Our goal is to make it easier for customers to discover your products, place orders and interact with your brand online.

benefits.title: Reach More Customers
benefits.description: Make your products accessible to customers beyond your physical location through an online store.

benefits.title: Convenient Shopping
benefits.description: Give customers an easy way to browse products and place orders whenever they want.

benefits.title: Stronger Brand Presence
benefits.description: Present your business professionally with a branded and consistent online shopping experience.

benefits.title: Simplified Order Management
benefits.description: Organise product listings and incoming customer orders in one digital storefront.

benefits.title: Room to Grow
benefits.description: Build an online store that can be expanded as your products and business needs evolve.

features.title: Custom Store Design
features.description: A branded storefront designed to reflect your business identity and products.

features.title: Product Management
features.description: Organised product listings with images, descriptions and pricing.

features.title: Shopping Cart
features.description: A convenient cart that allows customers to review products before checkout.

features.title: Checkout Integration
features.description: Checkout setup with suitable payment options, subject to provider availability and configuration.

features.title: Mobile-Friendly Experience
features.description: A responsive shopping experience across smartphones, tablets and desktop devices.

features.title: Order Management
features.description: Tools for reviewing and organising customer orders.

features.title: Store Administration
features.description: Guidance on managing products and basic store content.

processSteps.title: Discovery & Planning
processSteps.description: We discuss your business, products, target customers and e-commerce goals.

processSteps.title: Design & Structure
processSteps.description: We plan the storefront layout and create a shopping experience that reflects your brand.

processSteps.title: Development & Integration
processSteps.description: We build the store and configure its product catalogue, cart and agreed checkout integrations.

processSteps.title: Testing & Review
processSteps.description: We review the store's responsiveness, navigation and agreed shopping features before delivery.

processSteps.title: Launch & Handover
processSteps.description: We prepare the completed store for launch and provide guidance on basic administration.

faqs.question: Which payment gateways can you integrate?
faqs.answer: We configure integrations matching your region and platform—such as Stripe, Paystack, PayPal, or direct invoice/WhatsApp ordering.

faqs.question: Can my store support both physical and digital products?
faqs.answer: Yes. Product catalogs can handle shipped physical items, digital downloads, or service packages.

faqs.question: How do I add or update products later?
faqs.answer: We provide structured catalog management workflows or headless store admin dashboards tailored to your team.

idealFor: Retail brands, wholesalers, and entrepreneurs selling physical or digital products online.

seo.title: E-Commerce Development — TOP TECH
seo.description: Online stores, product catalogs, shopping carts, and custom e-commerce systems by TOP TECH.
